diagnosis.what_happened: Tables generated or merged in docx documents rendered as LTR in ONLYOFFICE because <w:bidiVisual> was appended to the end of <w:tblPr>.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Appending to the end places the tag after <w:tblW> or <w:tblBorders>, which violates the strict ECMA-376 schema ordering for CT_TblPr. Strict parsers ignore out-of-order tags.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: <w:bidiVisual> must be inserted in the correct sequence before <w:tblW> and <w:jc> in <w:tblPr>.
diagnosis.rationale_why: ECMA-376 XML schema strictly enforces the sequence of elements within complex types like CT_TblPr.

desired_behavior: Mandate schema-ordered <w:bidiVisual/> insertion before <w:tblW> in all table creation, and implement a universal table bidi enforcement sweep in all assembly and remediation scripts.
generalization: All OpenXML manipulations must strictly adhere to ECMA-376 sequence requirements, not just presence of tags.
